checked_claims.claim: Mission Kakatiya is a Telangana government programme to restore minor irrigation tanks and strengthen community irrigation management
checked_claims.limitation: Programme objective, not independently measured outcome.

checked_claims.claim: Government's 2014 minor irrigation source enumeration counted 46,531 tanks and other sources for planned phased restoration
checked_claims.limitation: Do NOT label 46,531 as a fresh 2026 tank count; official portal references old district structure.

checked_claims.claim: Tank-restoration works include desilting, feeder channels, bunds, weirs and sluices
checked_claims.limitation: Description of works, not verification of completion or net basin-wide water savings.

checked_claims.claim: UNESCO 2026 decision 48 COM 7B.11 welcomed reported progress toward extending Ramappa buffer zone to include canals and Lake Ramappa, encouraged minor boundary modification request by 1 February 2027 and noted updated HIA for PRASHAD
checked_claims.limitation: Do NOT claim the buffer-zone extension was already legally completed or the project received unconditional approval.

risk_note: Official Mission Kakatiya portal contains historical/political advocacy and district counts from earlier periods; use only attributed, dated programme details, not as independent impact evaluation.
